diagnosis: LMFE string enums are emitted literally (StringParsingState over allowed strings, no JSON escaping); review-v2 literal spans included the full title+newline+abstract source, so a chosen quote produced a raw newline inside a JSON string; json.loads failed and the EOS guard refused termination. Very likely the same cause as v2/v3 at query index 10.
fix: km-automatic-review-v3: spans split at newlines and any span containing control characters, quotes or backslashes is excluded; grammar cases review-multiline-line-span (accept) and review-multiline-full-source (reject)
